One of [[Huoba Neva]]'s '''parents''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who served on the [[Executive Board (SoroSuub Corporation)|Executive Board]] of the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. Their position within the company helped Neva to attain a place at the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]].<ref name="DE" />
